summary: Widget-level keyboard acceptance confirms the protected viewer traps Tab traversal on its only available action, closes on Escape, and restores focus to the exact image opener. Native screen-reader behavior remains unverified.

checks.name: Modal Tab traversal stays within the image viewer
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/message_attachment_list_test.dart --reporter expanded
checks.observation: In the unavailable-image state the close button is the only focusable dialog control. Two consecutive Tab presses keep the same focused control inside the route.

checks.name: Escape closes the image viewer and restores focus
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/message_attachment_list_test.dart --reporter expanded
checks.observation: After Escape removes the dialog, the same primary FocusNode that was associated with the keyed preview InkWell before opening is restored.

checks.name: Flutter test suite
checks.observation: All 246 widget and unit tests passed.

remaining: Verify actual keyboard focus and screen-reader announcements on native macOS, Windows, and Android devices. This does not close full DES-09 visual, protected ACL/download, or attachment-state acceptance.
